[Test][Misc] Replace HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE with ASCEND_ENABLE_USE_FABRIC_MEM in DeepSeek-V3.1T configs (#13857)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

This PR replaces the `HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE` environment variable with
`ASCEND_ENABLE_USE_FABRIC_MEM` in 5 DeepSeek-V3.1T YAML configurations.
These configurations represent A3 HCCS scenarios (`npu_per_node: 16`)
which should utilize the fabric memory path for optimal performance.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No.

### How was this patch tested?

Tested via existing E2E weekly multi-node tests.

- vLLM version: v0.26.0

- vLLM main: vllm-project/vllm@0351e9a

Signed-off-by: lizy124 <1950471827@qq.com>

[Refactor][quantization]Remove deprecated W4A8Linear/W8A8PDMixMoE schemes and sync W4A8 MoE refactor (#13713)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

- Part of https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/13318

Some quantization modes are sunset in this PR, including

- W4A8 Linear
- W4A8 Per-Group MoE(2 weight formats)
- W8A8 PDMix MoE

The reasons are as follows:
- It was a temporary solution and will not have any new evolution plan
in the future.
-    The performance is poor, and there are better alternatives.
- The application scope is small, and the maintenance difficulty is
increased.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

no

[Refactor][Ops] Simplify fused MoE runtime contracts (#13759)

## What this PR does / why we need it?

Simplify the fused MoE runtime contract by removing redundant dynamic
EPLB and log2phy plumbing from builder call sites, moving shared-expert
SwiGLU clamp parameters onto the shared expert executor, and updating
routed and quantized paths plus tests to match the streamlined
interface.

Remove  zero experts code in longcat.

## Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No. This is an internal refactor of the fused MoE runtime contract and
its test coverage.

[Doc] Sunset ASCEND_BUFFER_POOL environment variable (#13820)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Sunsets the `ASCEND_BUFFER_POOL` environment variable across the entire
repository (docs, tutorials, locale translations, and test
configurations).

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. `ASCEND_BUFFER_POOL` is removed and replaced by
`ASCEND_ENABLE_USE_FABRIC_MEM=1` or `HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE=1` depending
on the hardware and deployment path.

### How was this patch tested?

Verified zero remaining `ASCEND_BUFFER_POOL` occurrences across the
entire repository. Updated e2e multi-node and single-node test
configurations.

[CI]Skip error glm5.2 dspark test (#13832)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

This PR temporarily skips the GLM-5.2 DSpark acceptance test
(`test_glm_5_2_dspark_acceptance_tp8`) because the required
`confidence_head` tensors were not found in the checkpoint.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No.

### How was this patch tested?

Signed-off-by: wangkunpeng <1289706727@qq.com>
